tabs.html:
Corelink EPON OLT PON SFP Module 1.25G C+++ | 20km 9dBm High-Power Fiber Optic Module

Boost your fiber network performance with the Corelink EPON OLT PON SFP Module 1.25G C+++ 9dBm, designed for Gigabit Ethernet Passive Optical Network (EPON) applications. Engineered for OLT (Optical Line Terminal) systems, this high-quality, hot-swappable SFP transceiver delivers fast, stable, and long-distance fiber connectivity — up to 20 kilometers — with a powerful +9dBm optical output.


Ideal for FTTH (Fiber to the Home), FTTB (Fiber to the Building), and metro network applications, this industrial-grade module ensures reliable performance in extreme temperatures.


Why Choose the Corelink EPON OLT SFP Module?

  • Ultra-Fast 1.25Gbps Data Rate – High-speed bidirectional transmission (TX/RX).
  • Long-Distance Support – Transmit up to 20km over single-mode fiber (SMF).
  • High Optical Power – +3 to +9 dBm ensures strong, stable signal.
  • C+++ Grade Industrial Design – Withstands harsh environments (-40°C to +85°C).
  • Digital Diagnostics Monitoring (DDM) – Real-time diagnostics of temperature, voltage, and optical power.
  • IEEE 802.3ah Compliant – 100% compatible with industry-standard OLT equipment.
  • SC/UPC Connector – Easy and secure fiber connection.
  • Energy Efficient & Plug-and-Play – Simple installation, low power consumption.


Product Specifications:

  • Brand: Corelink
  • Data Rate: 1.25Gbps Downstream / Upstream
  • Wavelength: TX: 1490nm / RX: 1310nm
  • Transmission Distance: Up to 20km
  • Output Power: +3 to +9 dBm
  • Receiver Sensitivity: -30 dBm
  • Connector Type: SC/UPC
  • DDM/DOM: Supported
  • Operating Temp. : -40°C to +85°C (C+++ Grade)
  • Compliance IEEE 802.3ah, SFP MSA, RoHS

Compatible with All major EPON OLT brands

Best Use Cases:

EPON OLT modules for Fiber-to-the-Home (FTTH) deployments

Passive Optical Network (PON) architecture

Metro Ethernet and long-distance fiber communication

ISP and telecom backbone networks

Industrial-grade fiber optic networks
